summary_zh: 1982 年 GRiD Compass 采用翻盖式设计，成为早期笔记本电脑的重要代表；1981 年 Osborne 便携机与 Epson HX-20 等先驱也使「第一台笔记本」的定义存在争议。
summary_en: The 1982 GRiD Compass was an influential clamshell laptop. Earlier portable machines such as the 1981 Osborne and Epson HX-20 complicate claims to the first laptop.
notes: 笔记本的「第一」取决于是否要求翻盖结构、可在膝上使用或电池供电。1981 年 Osborne 1 是便携式电脑先驱，却更接近提箱式机器；Epson HX-20 以轻便与电池供电著称。此处选取 1982 年 GRiD Compass 的翻盖式形态，而非断言它是所有便携电脑的起点。
notes_en: Priority depends on requiring a clamshell, use on the lap or battery operation. The 1981 Osborne 1 was a portable pioneer but a luggable machine; the Epson HX-20 offered compact battery-powered computing. This entry selects the 1982 GRiD Compass for its clamshell form, rather than treating it as the origin of every portable computer.
